name: Math Commander
author: Addicting Games
description: Math Commander is a free educational game. Uh Oh, someone is trying to sink your battleship! Call the army, call the navy, call Rhiana, call whoever it takes to save the day and win the game. Math Commander is a game of skill and a game of guesses. You'll hide your fleet and then your AI opponent will take potshots at you as you try desperately to sink their ships first. Inbetween each volley you'll be tasked with answering math questions of your choice. You may choose the grade level and skill type as you go. This is a fun game for people who love math, love battles, and love ships! If you've ever dreamed of using letters and numbers in an effort to triangulate where an enemy might be hiding then this is absolutely the game for you. Get playing and have fun in this math-themed game of naval conquest.
